note: The investigation and identification procedure for a بیمه بدنه (vehicle body / monetary damage) claim. It is a gate-ordered questionnaire, not an interview script: each stage must close before the next one can decide anything, and every answer either binds a declared parameter slot, opens evidence, or routes the case. Questions cannot carry formulas and cannot set a payable: they feed knowledge/parameter_slots.json, which the branch engines in knowledge/branches.json read. Answers are `UNKNOWN` by design wherever the file does not yet say - UNKNOWN is a recorded state, never a silent default.

blocking_meanings.hard: the pipeline may not classify the branch until answered
blocking_meanings.amount: the branch may be chosen but no amount may be issued until the slot it feeds is supplied
blocking_meanings.review: an admissibility gate that must be escalated to a human; it never changes arithmetic silently

stages.name: Establish the file
stages.closes_when: the three event dates, the policy identity and the driver are recorded
stages.gate: A claim that cannot say when it happened, when the insured found out, and when it was declared cannot be dated, and every clock in this branch is event-dated.

stages.name: Identify the insured subject
stages.closes_when: vehicle type, use and declared accessories are recorded against the proposal form
stages.gate: The thing insured must be matched to the thing damaged before any value is discussed.

stages.name: Establish what happened and what caused it
stages.closes_when: one peril is selected from the closed list and the causal link is evidenced
stages.gate: Peril selects the branch family and the exclusion set; a guessed peril produces a confidently wrong calculation.

stages.name: Test cover before computing
stages.closes_when: every non-compensable condition is excluded or escalated, and held endorsements are separated from their terms
stages.gate: Two failure states must stay distinct: excluded-but-endorseable, and non-compensable. Collapsing them is the single most common wrong answer.

stages.name: Scope and classify the damage
stages.closes_when: each component has a category, the labour/parts split is known, and the theft or total-loss artefacts exist
stages.gate: Component classification is what selects the operators: glass exempt, battery/tyre capped, parts vs repair-only.

stages.name: Fix the value anchors
stages.closes_when: market value on the event date, insured sum and production year are all evidenced
stages.gate: These three numbers feed the total-loss test, the underinsurance ratio and the depreciation schedule at once.

stages.name: Read the contract's own economics
stages.closes_when: franchise mode, rate, base, sequence rule and source version are recorded, and other policies are listed
stages.gate: Everything the regulation leaves to the policy must be read from the policy. An assumed rate is a fabricated term.

stages.name: Classify the branch
stages.closes_when: the derived branch agrees with the evidence or an override is recorded with a reason
stages.gate: The decision tree runs on the answers above; a declared branch that contradicts the evidence is refused, not trusted.

stages.name: Lock the operators and their order
stages.closes_when: each configurable operator position has a source, or is left UNRESOLVED so the engine returns scenarios
stages.gate: Order is data. Locking it without a source manufactures false precision.

stages.name: Allocation, recourse and double cover
stages.closes_when: prior compensation, other insurers and any impairment of recourse are recorded
stages.gate: Recovery is not a discount on the payment calculation; it is a separate entitlement computed afterwards.

stages.name: Decide what may be issued
stages.closes_when: the pipeline returns COMPUTE, SCENARIO_SET, REFUSE or ESCALATE with reasons
stages.gate: This is the only stage that answers 'may the system issue one number?'

questions.ask: Which insurer issued the policy, and which product and policy version applies?
questions.ask_fa: بیمه‌گر، محصول و نسخه بیمه‌نامه؟
questions.why: Franchise and settlement practice are insurer- and version-specific; nothing below can be sourced without naming them. This answer identifies the file; it deliberately binds no calculation parameter.

questions.ask: On what date did the event occur?
questions.ask_fa: تاریخ وقوع حادثه؟
questions.why: The event date fixes the Iranian claim year, which drives both the depreciation index and the annual parameters.

questions.ask: On what date did the insured become aware of the loss?
questions.ask_fa: تاریخ اطلاع بیمه‌گذار از وقوع حادثه؟
questions.why: The notice clock runs from awareness, not from occurrence. Deriving one from the other hides a late-notice problem.

questions.ask: When was the loss declared, and was it within five working days of awareness?
questions.ask_fa: تاریخ اعلام خسارت و رعایت مهلت پنج روز کاری؟
questions.why: Breach lets the insurer reject, but only when the cause was avoidable. LATE is a review gate, never an automatic zero.

questions.ask: On what date was the loss declared to the insurer?
questions.ask_fa: تاریخ اعلام خسارت به بیمه‌گر؟
questions.why: The date and the timeliness judgement are different facts. Settlement clocks run from complete documents and, in insurer practice, the sixty-day theft count is often read against the declaration date, so the date itself must survive in the file.

questions.ask: Who was driving, and in what capacity relative to the insured?
questions.ask_fa: راننده چه کسی بود و نسبتش به بیمه‌گذار؟
questions.why: Intentional damage by the insured, a beneficiary or the driver is non-compensable, so the driver's identity is an exclusion input, not trivia.

questions.ask: Was the policy in force on the event date, with premium and instalments current?
questions.ask_fa: اعتبار بیمه‌نامه و وضعیت حق بیمه در تاریخ حادثه؟
questions.why: A policy that was not in force has no branch; continuing to calculate produces a number for a claim that does not exist.

questions.ask: What is the vehicle type and its declared use?
questions.ask_fa: نوع و مصرف اعلامی وسیله نقلیه؟
questions.why: The regulation covers land vehicles, and both the licence-appropriateness test and the parts/accessories limits depend on the declared type.

questions.ask: Were the damaged accessories or fittings listed in the proposal and approved by the insurer?
questions.ask_fa: لوازم و متعلقات معیوب در برگه پیشنهاد قید و تصویب شده بود؟
questions.why: Theft or damage of accessories is only covered for what the policy declares, and one insurer caps declared accessories at 20% of the vehicle value - a printed term, not a statutory rule.

questions.ask: Was the loss inside the Islamic Republic of Iran, or covered by a special agreement?
questions.ask_fa: وقوع خسارت داخل کشور یا با توافق خاص؟
questions.why: Territorial scope is an absolute gate in the general conditions.

questions.ask: Which insured peril caused the loss?
questions.ask_fa: کدام خطر بیمه‌شده سبب خسارت شد؟
questions.why: This is the branch key. Peril also decides which endorsement is needed and which exclusion list applies.

questions.ask: Is the causal link between that peril and this specific damage established by a report, or only asserted?
questions.ask_fa: رابطه سببیت بین خطر و خسارت مستند است یا ادعایی؟
questions.why: Positive covered-peril causation is an admission predicate. ASSERTED_ONLY must stop the pipeline; it must not be paid at a discount, because no coefficient is authorised anywhere. This does not alter the separate exclusion-causation guard G_NO_ASSUMED_CAUSATION.

questions.ask: For damage from struck or falling objects, parts, or cargo: was the vehicle in motion?
questions.ask_fa: در خسارت ناشی از اشیاء، قطعات یا بار: وسیله در حرکت بود؟
questions.why: The collision-type peril covers parts and cargo striking the vehicle while it is in motion; a parked-vehicle variant of the same story is a different risk.

questions.ask: Was another party involved, and what is the fault position recorded by the authority?
questions.ask_fa: طرف دیگر درگیر بود و نظر مقام انتظامی درباره تقصیر؟
questions.why: Fault does not reduce the body insurer's own obligation, but it identifies the recourse target and can trigger an insurer-specific franchise reduction that must be read from the policy, not assumed. Read together with Q-S9-01 before any reduction is contemplated.

questions.ask: Did the glass break on its own, or together with other damage from the same event?
questions.ask_fa: شیشه به‌تنهایی شکست یا همراه با سایر خسارت‌ها؟
questions.why: This single answer decides whether the claim is GLASS_ONLY (endorsement route) or PARTIAL_DAMAGE (base cover route). Getting it wrong applies the wrong franchise and the wrong depreciation rule.

questions.ask: For fire, lightning or explosion: is there an authority report establishing the cause?
questions.ask_fa: برای آتش‌سوزی/صاعقه/انفجار: گزارش علت توسط مرجع ذی‌صلاح؟
questions.why: Fire also has to be distinguished from intentional damage and from inherent electrical failure, which are non-compensable.

questions.ask: Which theft situation applies?
questions.ask_fa: کدام وضعیت سرقت؟
questions.why: Whole-vehicle theft has its own settlement; attempted theft is ordinary partial damage; parts theft is an endorsement question; parts stolen after an accident is an exclusion. Four answers, four routes.

questions.ask: What elapsed whole-day count is recorded for the missing vehicle?
questions.ask_fa: برای مدت فقدان خودرو چند روز کامل ثبت شده است؟
questions.why: This stored count is only a cross-check. The engine derives the authoritative interval from the separately sourced clock and refuses a mismatch.

questions.ask: Which sourced event starts the sixty-day whole-vehicle theft clock?
questions.ask_fa: کدام رویداد مستند، مبدأ مهلت شصت‌روزه سرقت کلی است؟
questions.why: The clock anchor is authority-sensitive. It must be selected explicitly from the controlling document, never inferred from an elapsed-day answer.

questions.ask: What is the sourced start date for that selected theft-clock event?
questions.ask_fa: تاریخ مستند رویداد مبدأ ساعت سرقت چیست؟
questions.why: A named start event without its evidenced date cannot produce a reproducible elapsed-day count.

questions.ask: Through which sourced as-of date has the vehicle remained undiscovered?
questions.ask_fa: عدم کشف خودرو تا کدام تاریخ مستند احراز شده است؟
questions.why: The review cut-off is a file fact, not the system date; preserving it makes the result reproducible.

questions.ask: Which calendar do the theft-clock dates use?
questions.ask_fa: تاریخ‌های ساعت سرقت بر اساس کدام تقویم هستند؟
questions.why: The same numeric date text has different meaning under Shamsi and Gregorian calendars; the engine must not guess.

questions.ask: Which document and locator authorize this theft-clock anchor and its dates?
questions.ask_fa: کدام سند و نشانی آن، مبدأ و تاریخ‌های ساعت سرقت را مستند می‌کند؟
questions.why: A date tuple without its controlling source cannot resolve the authority ambiguity recorded as U13.

questions.ask: Is the reported damage consistent with the stated event, or is there a discrepancy?
questions.ask_fa: خسارت اعلامی با ماجرای گزارش‌شده سازگار است؟
questions.why: Pre-existing damage and unexplained inconsistency are the two most common reasons an otherwise correct calculation produces the wrong payment.

questions.ask: What was the licence position of the driver at the time of the event?
questions.ask_fa: وضعیت گواهینامه راننده در زمان حادثه؟
questions.why: A void licence, a wrong class or no licence at all is non-compensable. An expired licence is expressly NOT treated as void, so one yes/no field cannot carry this.

questions.ask: Is there a competent-authority finding that alcohol or drugs were used, with a causal link to the loss?
questions.ask_fa: گزارش مقام ذی‌صلاح درباره مستی و تاثیر آن در وقوع حادثه؟
questions.why: Both parts are required: the authority report and causation. Suspicion is not a predicate the engine may apply.

questions.ask: Any sign of intentional damage by the insured, a beneficiary or the driver, or of loss while fleeing the authorities?
questions.ask_fa: علی‌رغم بیمه‌گذار/ذی‌نفع/راننده یا فرار از تعقیب مأمورین؟
questions.why: These are non-compensable and cannot be restored by endorsement. The exception written into the text - flight from unlawful occupants - must be recorded, not assumed away.

questions.ask: Do any of the remaining non-compensable conditions apply?
questions.ask_fa: سایر موارد غیرقابل جبران: جنگ، هسته‌ای، یدک غیرمجاز، بار بیش از حد، نقص ذاتی برق/الکتریک؟
questions.why: Each one is an absolute gate with its own evidence, and overload in particular is assessed against the plated capacity, not the driver's account.

questions.ask: Which endorsements does this policy actually carry?
questions.ask_fa: کدام الحاقیه‌ها واقعاً صادر شده‌اند؟
questions.why: Article 5 risks are outside the basic cover but restorable, so the endorsement list decides admissibility - while its printed schedule still decides the amount.

questions.ask: Was the vehicle moved or repaired before the insurer's consent or inspection?
questions.ask_fa: جابجایی یا تعمیر پیش از موافقت بیمه‌گر؟
questions.why: An unauthorised repair can destroy the assessment itself, which is an admissibility problem; a police-ordered move is expressly permitted.

questions.ask: Did the risk or the use of the vehicle intensify without notifying the insurer?
questions.ask_fa: تشدید خطر یا تغییر مصرف بدون اطلاع بیمه‌گر؟
questions.why: Where it applies, payment is reduced by the ratio of the premium charged to the premium appropriate to the intensified risk. That is a premium-ratio operator, not underinsurance, and this engine does not implement it - so YES escalates, while UNKNOWN or omission leaves a material fact unresolved and blocks authorization.

questions.ask: Was the vehicle sold or transferred after an accident that had not been declared?
questions.ask_fa: انتقال مالکیت پس از حادثه اعلام‌نشده؟
questions.why: The insurer owes nothing to a new owner for an undeclared earlier accident; who the claimant is becomes part of the classification.

questions.ask: Is the assessment itemised by component, or only an aggregate repair figure?
questions.ask_fa: ارزیابی قطعه‌به‌قطعه است یا یک رقم کلی؟
questions.why: Depreciation and the battery/tyre cap are component-level operators. An aggregate figure cannot be depreciated correctly, and it also feeds the 75% numerator.

questions.ask: What is the fair repair labour, separated from parts?
questions.ask_fa: دستمزد عادله تعمیر جدا از قیمت قطعات؟
questions.why: The partial-loss basis is fair labour plus the current price of replaced parts. Labour is not one of the depreciable items.

questions.ask: For each component: is it replaced or repaired only, and which category is it?
questions.ask_fa: هر قطعه: تعویضی یا تعمیرپذیر، و در کدام دسته؟
questions.why: Repair-only assessed cost remains eligible but takes zero replacement depreciation. Replaced glass and lamp glass remain depreciation-exempt; replaced battery and tyre retain the 50%-of-new cap and the existing interaction modes.

questions.ask: For each battery or tyre: what is its new price on the day of the event?
questions.ask_fa: قیمت نو باتری و لاستیک در روز حادثه؟
questions.why: The covered loss on these components is capped at half of new, which cannot be computed without the new price. If the vehicle is also old enough to depreciate, the cap and the schedule collide.

questions.ask: Did the assessor state depreciation as a figure, or should it be computed from the production year?
questions.ask_fa: استهلاک توسط کارشناس رقم‌خورده است یا محاسبه شود؟
questions.why: Both routes are legitimate, but they must not be mixed in one claim: the audit trace states which one produced the deduction.

questions.ask: Has the registration been transferred to the insurer, and when?
questions.ask_fa: سند مالکیت به نام بیمه‌گر منتقل شده است؟
questions.why: Total theft settlement requires the transfer first, and where the insurer takes title the salvage value must not also be deducted.

questions.ask: What rescue, mitigation or transport cost was actually incurred, and with invoices?
questions.ask_fa: هزینه نجات، پیشگیری و حمل واقعاً پرداختی و مستندات؟
questions.why: The evidenced actual amount is used once in the total-loss numerator when no distinct threshold interpretation exists. Settlement keeps the actual and capped payable amounts separate; a capped payable is never copied back into classification.

questions.ask: What is the probable salvage value, and does the insured accept it?
questions.ask_fa: ارزش بازیافتی احتمالی و موضع بیمه‌گذار درباره آن؟
questions.why: Salvage comes off the settlement base before the total-loss franchise is computed; a disputed valuation changes the disposition instead.

questions.ask: Who keeps the wreck?
questions.ask_fa: خودرو معیوب از چه کسی باقی می‌ماند؟
questions.why: Salvage subtraction and title transfer are alternatives. Doing both underpays twice; doing neither overpays.

questions.ask: Where the assessment cannot be itemised, what is the aggregate repair-and-replacement figure excluding rescue and transport?
questions.ask_fa: در صورت عدم امکان تفکیک قطعات، مجموع هزینه تعمیر و تعویض بدون هزینه نجات و حمل چقدر است؟
questions.why: The aggregate repair/replacement operand must exclude separately recorded rescue so the total-loss numerator adds rescue exactly once. If an assessment embeds rescue, evidence must decompose it or the material classification remains blocked.

questions.ask: Is the vehicle repairable at all, or is repair technically impossible?
questions.ask_fa: خودرو قابل تعمیر است یا تعمیر ممتنع؟
questions.why: The regulation's test is arithmetic - repair plus rescue exceeding 75% of value - so a technical opinion must still be evidenced by the two numbers that compute it.

questions.ask: What was the transactional value of the vehicle on the day of the event, and on what evidence?
questions.ask_fa: ارزش معاملاتی در روز حادثه و مستند آن؟
questions.why: One number, three jobs: the 75% denominator, the underinsurance denominator, and the total-loss settlement base.

questions.ask: What insured sum does the policy state for the year of the event?
questions.ask_fa: مبلغ بیمه‌شده در سال وقوع حادثه؟
questions.why: With the market value this is the ratio; without it, underinsurance is unassessed and must be labelled as such rather than treated as full cover.

questions.ask: What is the production (model) year, taken from the registration or the policy schedule?
questions.ask_fa: سال تولید از سند یا بیمه‌نامه؟
questions.why: It decides the depreciation year index: nothing before the fifth production year, 5% per year after that, capped at 25%. In the fifth year itself the deduction is already 5%, so an off-by-one here is a real amount error.

questions.ask: Does the difference between market value and insured sum look like under-insurance, or like a value dispute?
questions.ask_fa: تفاوت ارزش و مبلغ بیمه: کم‌بیمه‌گی یا اختلاف در ارزش‌گذاری؟
questions.why: The ratio is mandatory where cover is short of value, but a disputed valuation is an evidence problem: fixing it by adjusting the insured sum would manufacture a payment.

questions.ask: How is the franchise expressed in this policy: a percentage, a fixed amount, or a percentage with a minimum?
questions.ask_fa: نحوه بیان فرانشیز در بیمه‌نامه؟
questions.why: The regulation defines franchise as the insured's share whose amount the policy specifies. It sets no rate, so the schedule must be read rather than remembered.

questions.ask: What rate or amount, and for which coverage line (base damage, theft, partial theft, glass, natural disaster)?
questions.ask_fa: نرخ یا مبلغ و برای کدام پوشش؟
questions.why: Franchise rates differ per coverage line within one policy. A rate copied from the wrong line silently overpays or underpays.

questions.ask: What is the calculation base the rate applies to, and is there a minimum?
questions.ask_fa: مبنای محاسبه فرانشیز و حداقل آن؟
questions.why: Percent-of-what is the whole question: gross damage, damage after depreciation, or the settlement base give different answers, and the regulation does not choose.

questions.ask: What is the claim-sequence rule and which dated document is its source?
questions.ask_fa: قاعده ترتیب خسارت (اول/بعدی) و منبع تاریخ‌دار آن؟
questions.why: One insurer doubles the rate from the second claim and halves the first-claim rate when the insured was not at fault; another counts claims per policy year in a multi-year contract. None of that is law, so it needs a dated source.

questions.ask: Is the same vehicle insured against the same risk under any other policy?
questions.ask_fa: بیمه مضاعف: بیمه‌نامه دیگر برای همان وسیله و خطر؟
questions.why: Without fraud Article 21 permits settlement followed by contribution. This implementation records that rule but routes YES_* to review until a contribution implementation is approved; that block is an implementation limitation, not a legal prohibition on settlement.

questions.ask: Does the glass endorsement print a valuation condition or a ceiling on the glass it will pay for?
questions.ask_fa: الحاقیه شیشه: شرط بیمه‌شدن به قیمت روز یا سقف ارزش؟
questions.why: At least one insurer's printed glass cover is conditioned on the vehicle being insured at market value, which would remove the standalone route for an under-insured vehicle. That is a policy term: read it, and do not generalise it into a rule.

questions.ask: Is any part of this loss also a third-party or legal-recovery claim that must be split into its own file?
questions.ask_fa: آزم بخشی از خسارت ثالث مالی یا مطالبه حقوقی است و باید فایل جدا شود؟
questions.why: One accident can generate three different calculations with three different rules. A body branch must not import the third-party cap, and neither may import body depreciation and franchise.

questions.ask: Where does the underinsurance ratio run relative to the franchise, and on whose authority?
questions.ask_fa: محل اعمال قاعده نسبی نسبت به فرانشیز و مرجع تعیین آن؟
questions.why: Both operators are mandatory and their order is unstated. Only a worksheet or an official clarification may lock it; anything else returns two sourced scenarios.

questions.ask: For an old vehicle with a damaged battery or tyre: cap then depreciate, depreciate then cap, or cap only?
questions.ask_fa: خودرو قدیمی با باتری/لاستیک معیوب: ترتیب سقف و استهلاک؟
questions.why: Two rules exist in the text and their interaction is not described. Stacking them silently is the classic double-deduction error.

questions.ask: Which figure is the denominator of the 20% rescue ceiling for this claim?
questions.ask_fa: مخرج سقف بیست درصد هزینه نجات در این پرونده؟
questions.why: The ceiling is stated as a percentage of total damage without defining total. The choice is only material when the claim is near the cap.

questions.ask: Will this settle as cash, repair in kind, or a replacement vehicle?
questions.ask_fa: نحوه تسویه: نقد، تعمیر، یا جایگزینی؟
questions.why: The mode changes delivery, not arithmetic: the regulation keeps franchise and depreciation on the insured either way. Recording it prevents a repair-in-kind settlement from quietly dropping both operators.

questions.ask: Which annual parameter set applies to the event year, and has it been revalidated against the primary announcement?
questions.ask_fa: مجموعه پارامترهای سال وقوع حادثه و اعتبارسنجی اولیه آن؟
questions.why: The annual bodily ceiling derives the conventional-vehicle threshold and the minimum financial commitment. A missing year silently borrows current-year figures, and for body-only claims these parameters are simply not in play.

questions.ask: Has the insured released, settled with, or obstructed recovery against the responsible party?
questions.ask_fa: اسقاط، سازش یا ایجاد مانع در رجوع به مسئول؟
questions.why: Impairing recourse lets the insurer refuse payment or recover what it paid. It is a review decision, not an arithmetic deduction.

questions.ask: Is a responsible party identified and solvent enough to be pursued?
questions.ask_fa: مسئول_identified و قابل مراجعه؟
questions.why: Whether the insurer pays first and pursues later, or must leave a residual claim with the insured, depends on this - and on the double-insurance answer in S6.

questions.ask: Has any compensation already been received for this same damage, from any source?
questions.ask_fa: خسارت یکسان قبلاً از هر مصدری پرداخت شده؟
questions.why: Record compensation already received for this same damage from any source independently of the other-policy state. A positive amount blocks calculation until an approved allocation or remainder implementation exists; no formula is inferred here.

questions.ask: Who reviewed the file, and does the issued decision match the computed outcome?
questions.ask_fa: نام بازبین و تایید تطابق تصمیم با خروجی محاسبه؟
questions.why: The ladder only certifies a tier when a named reviewer has reconciled the system's decision with the file. Silent agreement is not evidence.
